place.source_title: Chanute Air Force Base, Non-Commissioned Officer Housing, Galaxy Street

brief: Two-storey side-gabled brick duplex of about 1942 with a pedimented double-door porch and iron rails at the steps, a small one-storey frame side addition and an end chimney.

floors: W W W W W W
W W D D W W
facade.notes: Chanute Field non-commissioned officers' housing (Rantoul IL, 1942): two-storey hip-roofed brick duplexes of one standard plan, paired doors under a shared pedimented hood with fanlights, an iron-railed stoop, a tall end chimney, 6/6 sash; foundation shrubs; set evenly along a sidewalk with lawns flowing between (this one with a small frame side addition)

why.note: Army standard-plan NCO quarters: two families per building, repeated
the Quartermaster Corps' Colonial Revival brick of the 1930s-40s bases
